title: Admission Counsellor
description:
**Job Title: International Admissions Counsellor**

**Department:** Admissions & Business Development  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years (Experience in overseas education counselling preferred)  
**Reporting To:** HR Manager

***About the Role***

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and student-focused International Admissions Counsellor who will be responsible for identifying prospective students, generating admission enquiries, counselling students and parents, and converting qualified leads into successful international university admissions.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong knowledge of overseas education opportunities, and the ability to understand students' academic aspirations and guide them towards suitable universities and programmes abroad.

The candidate will act as a key point of contact throughout the student's admission journey, ensuring a seamless experience from the initial enquiry to university application, offer acceptance, and enrolment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Student Counselling & Guidance**

* Counsel prospective students and parents regarding overseas education opportunities.
* Understand students' academic backgrounds, career aspirations, interests, and financial capabilities.
* Recommend suitable countries, universities, colleges, and courses based on individual profiles.
* Provide guidance on admission eligibility, academic requirements, and application procedures.
* Explain available programmes, tuition fees, scholarships, and career opportunities.
* Conduct one-on-one counselling sessions, telephonic consultations, and virtual meetings.
* Build trust and maintain long-term relationships with students and parents.

**2. Student Acquisition & Admission Conversion**

* Generate prospective student enquiries through telecalling, references, social media, educational events, and other channels.
* Proactively identify and engage potential students interested in studying abroad.
* Follow up with prospective students through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and meetings.
* Convert enquiries into counselling sessions and counselling sessions into confirmed applications and admissions.
* Maintain a healthy admission pipeline and consistently achieve assigned admission targets.
* Develop referral networks with existing students, parents, schools, colleges, and educational institutions.
* Participate in education fairs, university events, seminars, webinars, and admission drives.

**3. International University & Course Knowledge**

* Maintain updated knowledge of international universities and their admission requirements.
* Understand overseas education destinations such as:
* United Kingdom (UK)
* United States (USA)
* Canada
* Australia
* New Zealand
* Germany
* Ireland
* France and other European countries.
* Stay informed about university rankings, intakes, application deadlines, tuition fees, scholarships, and entry requirements.
* Research and identify suitable universities and programmes for prospective students.
* Keep track of changing admission policies and international education trends.

**4. Application & Documentation Management**

* Assist students with university shortlisting and application submissions.
* Guide students in preparing academic documents, SOPs, LORs, resumes, and other application requirements.
* Ensure applications are complete, accurate, and submitted within deadlines.
* Coordinate with university admission representatives and international institutional partners.
* Track application status and provide timely updates to students.
* Follow up on conditional and unconditional offer letters.
* Assist students with acceptance procedures and tuition deposit guidance.

**5. Visa & Pre-Departure Assistance**

* Provide preliminary guidance regarding student visa processes and documentation.
* Familiarise students with country-specific visa requirements and procedures.
* Coordinate with authorised visa consultants where required.
* Guide students regarding accommodation, travel, insurance, and pre-departure formalities.
* Conduct pre-departure orientation sessions to prepare students for their international education journey.

**6. Lead Management & CRM**

* Maintain an updated database of prospective students and admission enquiries.
* Record all interactions, follow-ups, counselling sessions, and application updates in the CRM.
* Categorise leads based on their interest, eligibility, budget, and admission readiness.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission reports.
* Monitor lead conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve the admission funnel.
* Ensure no prospective student enquiry is left unattended.

**7. Business Development & Institutional Partnerships**

* Build relationships with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and educational consultants.
* Identify opportunities for student acquisition and institutional collaborations.
* Support marketing initiatives, admission campaigns, webinars, and promotional activities.
* Represent the organisation professionally during education fairs and university meetings.
* Contribute innovative ideas to increase student enrolments and strengthen the organisation's international admissions network.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

The ideal candidate should possess the following qualities:

* **Excellent Communication Skills:** Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication abilities.
* **Active Listening:** Ability to understand students' concerns, aspirations, and expectations.
* **Persuasive Skills:** Ability to influence decisions ethically and convert prospective enquiries into admissions.
* **Empathy & Patience:** Must be approachable, supportive, and patient while dealing with students and parents.
* **Sales & Conversion Mindset:** Ability to work towards targets and achieve admission conversion goals.
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to establish trust and maintain strong relationships with prospective students.
* **Problem-Solving Ability:** Ability to address student concerns and provide practical solutions.
* **Research & Analytical Skills:** Ability to compare universities, courses, eligibility criteria, and admission opportunities.
* **Time Management:** Ability to manage multiple student applications and deadlines simultaneously.
* **Negotiation Skills:** Ability to handle fee-related discussions, objections, and parent concerns professionally.
* **Attention to Detail:** Accuracy in application documentation and student records.
* **Professionalism:** Strong ownership, accountability, ethical conduct, and a student-first approach.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 1–4 years of experience in admissions counselling, overseas education, student recruitment, educational sales, or business development.
* Prior experience with international university applications and student admissions will be an advantage.
* Freshers with exceptional communication, interpersonal, and sales abilities may also be considered.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, MS Excel, Google Workspace, and digital communication tools.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified student leads generated.
* Number of counselling sessions conducted.
* Lead-to-counselling conversion ratio.
* Counselling-to-application conversion ratio.
* Application-to-offer conversion ratio.
* Offer-to-enrolment conversion ratio.
* Number of confirmed student admissions.
* Follow-up efficiency and lead response time.
* Student and parent satisfaction.
* Accuracy and timely completion of applications.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly admission targets.

**Personal Attributes We Value**

**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Highly motivated and passionate about education.
* Confident, articulate, and approachable.
* Target-driven without compromising student interests.
* Proactive and capable of working independently.
* Adaptable to changing international admission requirements.
* Comfortable interacting with students, parents, and international university representatives.
* Willing to learn, take ownership, and contribute to business growth.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in the international education sector.
* Professional growth and learning opportunities.
* Exposure to international universities and education systems.
* Performance-based incentives linked to admission conversions.
* A collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.

**Our Expectation:** We are looking for an individual who does not simply answer admission enquiries but takes ownership of the complete student journey - from the first interaction to successful international enrolment.

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description**

Position: Product Application – Solar Inverter / PCS

Experience: 7–10 Years  
Department: Product Application / Technical  
Industry: Solar PV / Energy Storage / Power Electronics  
Location: Gurgaon India.

1. **Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Product Application Engineer / Technical Subject Matter Expert to support the technical application, system design, product positioning, and engineering of Central/String Inverters, PCS, and BESS solutions. The role will work closely with customers, EPCs, consultants, utilities, Sales, R&D, Engineering, Service, and Project teams to develop technically compliant, optimized, and commercially competitive solutions for utility-scale and C&I projects.

2. **Key Responsibilities**

Product Application & System Engineering

* Understand customer/project requirements and recommend suitable inverter/PCS solutions.
* Perform product selection, sizing, system configuration, DC/AC ratio, voltage/current assessment, loading, and derating calculations.
* Evaluate application requirements considering ambient temperature, altitude, humidity, installation configuration, and site conditions.
* Support integration of inverters/PCS with PV modules, transformers, MV systems, SCBs, BESS, EMS, SCADA, PPC, and grid protection systems.
* Review and interpret SLDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications, and system architectures.
* Perform technical assessments including transformer sizing/impedance, short-circuit calculations, maximum DC voltage/current, and system-level electrical requirements.

Customer, Consultant & Pre-Sales Support

* Act as the technical interface for customers, EPCs, utilities, and other stakeholders.
* Review tenders/RFPs, technical specifications, and prepare compliance requirements and identify deviations.
* Prepare technical offers, compliance matrices, clarifications, deviations, and solution proposals.
* Lead/participate in technical meetings, presentations, product demonstrations, and technical negotiations.
* Provide technical support to Sales throughout the pre-sales and project development cycle.

Product & Market Development

* Gather customer/market requirements and translate them into actionable inputs for Product Management and R&D.
* Identify product capability gaps and support development of application-specific solutions.
* Support new product introduction, product benchmarking, and competitor technical analysis.
* Support resolution of complex technical/application issues and disseminate learnings across relevant teams.

3. **Required Technical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Solar PV Inverters, Central/String Inverters, PCS and BESS.
* Good understanding of power electronics, inverter topologies, and grid-connected power conversion systems.
* Knowledge of power transformers, MV/HV systems, switchgear, protection, cables, SPD, grounding/earthing, and electrical safety.
* Ability to understand and evaluate grid integration, system configuration, and electrical performance requirements.
* Proficiency in interpreting and preparing SLDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to engage effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

4. **Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's/master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering or Power System.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in Solar Inverters, PCS/BESS, power electronics, EPC, system engineering, or related renewable-energy industries.
* Experience in utility-scale solar/BESS projects and customer/consultant technical interfaces will be preferred.
* Preferred experience having knowledge of simulation (PSSE and PSCAD)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present and defend technical solutions effectively.

title: Presales & Tender Manager
description:
**Company Overview**

E.Biz is India's largest Tier-1 dealer for Motorola Two-Way Radios and a rising force in developing and manufacturing advanced telecom products. With over 25 years of established presence in the Indian telecommunication market, E.Biz specializes in state-of-the-art communication solutions, including:

* Motorola Two-Way Radio Cap-plus and Cap-max system
* Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC) Solutions
* Underground Mining SCADA Projects & Tunnel Communication
* Satellite Communication, Camera and PA system specially for Hydrocarbon Industry

We serve critical sectors across India, including Government bodies, PSUs, Oil & Gas, Railways, Infrastructure Projects, and major Corporates. E.Biz proudly partners with global OEMs such as Motorola, Radwin, Proxim ,Becker Varis, Honneywell, Armtel and commend .

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and technically competent **Pre-Sales & Tender Manager** to drive business growth by identifying, evaluating, and securing high-value contracts across Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Government departments, and Corporate accounts.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete pre-sales and tendering lifecycle, from identifying business opportunities and analysing customer requirements to designing technical solutions, preparing specifications and Bills of Materials (BOMs), coordinating with OEMs, and submitting technically compliant and commercially competitive bids.

The ideal candidate must possess strong technical expertise, system design capabilities, tender management experience, and the ability to develop end-to-end solutions using the most suitable products and technologies available in the market.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Tender Identification & Management**

* Identify and evaluate business opportunities through GeM, CPPP, PSU portals, e-procurement platforms, and direct customer interactions.
* Analyse tender documents, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, commercial terms, and contractual conditions.
* Manage the complete tendering process, including pre-bid queries, technical clarifications, corrigenda, bid preparation, submission, and post-submission follow-up.
* Ensure timely submission of accurate, complete, and technically compliant bids.
* Maintain a tender pipeline, track bid status, and identify potential risks and opportunities.

**2. Technical Solution Design & Engineering**

* Take complete responsibility for the technical design and engineering of proposed systems.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into practical, cost-effective, and technically sound solutions.
* Prepare solution architecture, system configurations, network diagrams, equipment layouts, and technical presentations.
* Develop detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs), including equipment, accessories, software, licences, infrastructure, and services.
* Evaluate products from multiple OEMs and select the most suitable brands and technologies based on performance, compliance, reliability, availability, and cost.
* Ensure that proposed solutions meet the customer's technical, operational, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept exercises, and system presentations at customer sites.
* Support technical discussions with customers, consultants, project teams, and end users.

**3. Technical Specifications and Compliance**

* Analyse complex technical specifications and identify deviations, gaps, and potential compliance risks.
* Prepare detailed technical proposals, product datasheets, compliance statements, and point-by-point compliance matrices.
* Develop and recommend appropriate technical specifications in line with customer requirements, industry standards, and project objectives.
* Coordinate with customers and consultants to clarify technical requirements and resolve specification-related issues.
* Evaluate competing technologies and products to establish technically robust and commercially viable solutions.

**Job Requirements**

* **Experience:** 5 to 15 years of proven experience in Pre-Sales, Bid Management, or Government Tendering profiles (specifically dealing with PSUs and GeM portal).
* **Industry Knowledge:** Prior exposure to telecom, radio communication, networking, or electronic security systems is highly advantageous.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong time-management skills with the ability to multitask and meet rigid deadlines under pressure.
* A self-motivated, detail-oriented, and highly organized approach to work.

**Qualifications**

* **Technical Degree:** B.Tech / B.E. / Diploma / B.Sc in Electronics & Communication, Electronics.
* **Management Degree:** BBA or MBA (preferred but not mandatory if technical / tendering experience is strong).

**Compensation & Location**

* **Job Location:** Delhi-NCR
* **Remuneration:** ₹6,00,000 – ₹24,00,000 Per Annum

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

title: Presales Executive (Real Estate)
description:
Role Overview

* **Department:** Presales
* **Location:** Gurugram
* **Reporting To:** TL \- Sales
* **Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Key Responsibilities

* **Partner Engagement:** Build and maintain strong relationships with registered channel partners, brokers, and real estate agents.
* **Lead Qualification:** Handle incoming leads generated through the channel partner network and check them for quality and authenticity.
* **Database Management:** Update and maintain the CRM database with accurate partner details, client site visits, and deal statuses.
* **Coordination:** Coordinate with the sales team to schedule site visits and meetings between clients, channel partners, and closing managers.
* **Query Resolution:** Resolve day\-to\-day queries from brokers regarding project updates, pricing, construction status, and commission payouts.
* **Campaign Support:** Assist in rolling out new project launches, promotional offers, and incentive schemes to the partner network.

Requirements and Skills

* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of experience in real estate presales, inside sales, or channel partner operations.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and local languages.
* **Tech Skills:** Proficiency in MS Office and popular real estate CRM software.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Strong networking skills with a persuasive and professional approach.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
